name: View-invariant Contrastive Loss
definition: A regularization scheme to ensure the latent code does not depend on 2D viewpoints but truly reflects 3D edits, preventing instability if the code violently changes given images similar in appearance but different in viewpoints.
summary: View-invariant Contrastive Loss regularizes generative NeRF latent codes to reflect 3D content variations independently of 2D viewpoints, preventing optimization instability.
